messages:
sachin: Quick heads-up — I'm about to land a tiny Terraform change that switches per-model ConfigMap mounts from a single global path to model-scoped paths. This should stop accidental cross-model overrides but will change mount paths from `/etc/models/global-config` -> `/etc/models/<model>/config`. Need quick 👍 or concerns before I merge.

maria: can you paste the TF diff and confirm if this forces pod restarts? cc @eng-runtime

jonathan: also: does this affect any init containers or the secret-sync job we run? we have a couple of hacks expecting the global path.

sachin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 — main bits:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_config_map" "model_cfg" {
  for_each = var.models
  metadata {
    name      = "model-config-${each.key}"
    namespace = each.value.namespace
  }
  data = each.value.config
}
```
Mount change in Deployment template from:
```
- mountPath: /etc/models/global-config
+ mountPath: /etc/models/${MODEL_NAME}/config
```
This will cause rolling restarts because the pod spec changes. Plan to do canary on `staging` then `canary` rollout for 10% of traffic.

kevin: for compatibility, can we drop a tiny init container that symlinks old path -> new path? that would avoid updating all jobs at once.

sachin: yeah that's the plan if we need a safer rollout. Example init snippet: 
```yaml
- name: cfg-symlink
  image: busybox
  command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "mkdir -p /etc/models/$MODEL_NAME && ln -sfn /etc/models/$MODEL_NAME/config /etc/models/global-config"]
  env:
    - name: MODEL_NAME
      valueFrom:
        fieldRef:
          fieldPath: metadata.labels['model']
```
This will be toggled by a feature flag `per_model_mount_enabled` in the infra helm values so we can roll it out cluster-wide when ready.

deploy-bot: Created PR check: infra#432 — plan: apply to `staging` tonight 02:00 UTC, hold for 1 hour, then promote if no errors.

maria: small Q — secrets: do we still mount secrets in the same pattern? the syncer writes secrets into `model-namespace` — the app code reads `/etc/models/{model}/secrets` today? if not, we need a short adapter.

jonathan: short-term we can keep the secret-sync job writing both paths (old and new) for 48 hours. longer term, update syncer to write only model namespace.

kevin: code owners pinged on the PR. if nobody objects, I'll approve and we can run staging canary tonight.

sachin: thanks — if you see anything unexpected in the plan output (resource diffs or additional pods touched) notify here. I'll post the `terraform plan` summary in a minute. :thumbsup:
